# Note Templates

Templates provide consistent structures for different types of knowledge entries.

They are not published as part of the documentation site. They serve as starting points when creating new notes.

---

## Available Templates

| Template        | Purpose                 | Example Uses                                         |
| --------------- | ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `concept.md`    | General knowledge notes | Mathematical concepts, theories, technologies, ideas |
| `book-note.md`  | Reading notes           | Textbooks, monographs, historical works              |
| `paper-note.md` | Research paper analysis | Academic papers, technical reports                   |
| `cheatsheet.md` | Quick reference         | Commands, syntax, formulas                           |
| `project.md`    | Project documentation   | Software projects, research projects, experiments    |

---

# How to Use

Copy the appropriate template:

```bash
cp docs/templates/concept.md docs/foundations/mathematics/new-topic.md
```
